description: Source code for Dcm_Dsl module in an AUTOSAR-based automotive diagnostic stack, implementing diagnostic session management, message handling, and protocol control.

methods.name: DslInit
methods.description: Initializes the Dcm_Dsl module, setting buffer statuses, security levels, and session control to default states.

methods.name: DslMain
methods.description: Main processing loop handling session timeouts, message transmission, and protocol state management.

methods.name: DslProvideRxBufferToPdur
methods.description: Provides a receive buffer to the PduR for incoming diagnostic messages, managing external and local buffers.

methods.name: DslRxIndicationFromPduR
methods.description: Handles indications from PduR that a message has been received, starting or preempting protocols as needed.

methods.name: DslProvideTxBuffer
methods.description: Provides a transmit buffer to the transport layer for sending diagnostic responses.

methods.name: DslTxConfirmation
methods.description: Handles confirmation from the transport layer that a message has been transmitted, releasing buffers accordingly.

methods.name: DslGetActiveProtocol
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active protocol ID.

methods.name: DslSetSecurityLevel
methods.description: Sets the security level for the current protocol session.

methods.name: DslSetSesCtrlType
methods.description: Sets the session control type, possibly triggering a session change.

methods.name: DslGetSesCtrlType
methods.description: Retrieves the current session control type.

methods.name: DslResetSessionTimeoutTimer
methods.description: Resets the session timeout timer for the active protocol.

methods.name: DslInternal_ResponseOnOneDataByPeriodicId
methods.description: Triggers a response with data identified by a periodic ID.
